name: Ningxia Western Venture Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningxia Western Venture Industrial Co.,Ltd. engages in the railway transportation business in China. It operates through Railway Transportation and Services, Wine and Hotel Services, and Supply Chain Services segments. The company engages in the railway transportation of coal, iron ore, and coal chemical products; road-rail intermodal transport, container multimodal transport, and railway logistics park operation; hotel services; and supply chain trade services, which include procurement, transportation, warehousing, sales, information, and other services.
